title: Cairns, Queensland — Cost of Living, Housing & Relocation Guide [2026]
description: Complete guide to Cairns, Queensland: cost of living, home prices, neighborhoods, remote work readiness, and relocation tips.
content:
Overview

Cairns is a city in Queensland with a population of 169,312. Gateway to the Great Barrier Reef and Daintree Rainforest with a vibrant tourism and backpacker scene. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 7a growing zone supports Mild — wide variety of vegetables, many fruit trees. The city enjoys abundant sunshine, with about 265 sunny days a year. Reported crime rates are relatively low.
